speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition better, could you tell me how long you have been experiencing this fatigue and weight loss, and have you noticed any shortness of breath or difficulty breathing when lying flat?

speaker: Patient
text: 66-year-old white male. The patient reports a 10-day history of fatigue and bilateral lower leg swelling. He mentions a weight loss of 3.6 kg (8 lbs) over the past 6 months without trying. He has a history of chronic bronchitis and uses an albuterol inhaler as needed.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any shortness of breath when lying flat, or do you need extra pillows to sleep comfortably? Also, have you noticed any abdominal distension or pain?

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes, or changes in the color of your urine and stool? Also, do you experience any right-sided abdominal pain or a feeling of fullness in your upper abdomen after eating?
